answer: Proposal: an answer counts only if its account holds nine same-epoch tokens from distinct standing members; each member's ledger budget is three spends, and the counter rejects a fourth. If a jury convicts the account, every endorser of record loses standing, so rented tokens price in fraud risk. Fresh accounts mint no tokens, so a comet of sign-ups stalls: with M standing members, growth ≤ M/3 per epoch, machine count irrelevant. The kernel is the counted spend — each token an opal, not a reprintable coupon. Seams: budget-renting cabals, patient clean fakes.
